name: Omacube
author: Tiedeyez
description: An animated desktop background of an endless isometric stack of 3x3 puzzle cubes, drawn flat in sticker colours. Cubes turn their layers and tumble on their own clocks while the field drifts slowly past, and every workspace switch rolls the whole stack 120 degrees so it clicks back into line like a cube turn. One GPU fragment shader, no files, processes or network.
